description: This file contains unit tests for the BearerTokenValidator class within the OAuth server implementation of the OrangeHRM system. It tests various scenarios related to OAuth token validation, including missing headers, invalid tokens, expired tokens, revoked tokens, and valid tokens. The tests verify correct exception handling and access token retrieval.

classes.name: BearerTokenValidatorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the functionality of OAuth Bearer Token validation in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including populating test data fixtures and setting up repository and encryption key.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithoutAuthorizeHeader
methods.description: Tests validation behavior when no Authorization header is present in the request.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidHeaderValue
methods.description: Tests validation behavior when an invalid Authorization header value is provided.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidToken
methods.description: Tests validation when an invalid token is provided in the Authorization header.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithInvalidEncryptionKey
methods.description: Tests behavior when the decryption key does not match the key used to encrypt the token.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithRevokedToken
methods.description: Tests behavior when a revoked access token is used.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithNonExistingToken
methods.description: Tests behavior when a valid token decrypts to a token ID that does not exist in the database.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredToken
methods.description: Tests behavior when a token has expired based on current time.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredTokenAfterOneYear
methods.description: Tests expiration handling when current time is more than a year after token expiry.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorizationWithExpiredAndCurrentTimeSame
methods.description: Tests behavior when token expiry and current time are the same.

methods.name: testValidateAuthorization
methods.description: Tests valid token validation and extraction of access token details.
